text: The package checked for container indicators (/.dockerenv and /proc/1/cgroup) and attempted to contact c2.rh-zoo.invalid; the microVM run exposed that destination while the sandbox run did not, which is consistent with sandbox evasion. That matters because an attempted command-and-control contact combined with hiding from the sandbox is high-risk behavior, even though the fake network contained it. The reviewer should not merge this package, should quarantine or remove it, and should escalate for further investigation.
